lead.title: Lilly buys UK-based LoQus23 for up to $725M for its oral MSH3 inhibitor in Huntington's disease, before it has even reached the clinic
lead.deck: The Cambridge biotech, founded in 2019 by David Reynolds, Ruth McKernan and Caroline Benn at SV Health Investors' Dementia Discovery Fund and backed by a £35M Series A led by Forbion in 2024, is being sold for an undisclosed upfront plus milestone payments. Its candidate LQT-23 blocks MSH3, a DNA-repair protein that drives the 'somatic' expansion of CAG repeats in the huntingtin gene: a bet on modifying the course of the disease, paid for at the preclinical stage, with a clinical trial application expected by the end of 2026.

milestone.title: An eGenesis gene-edited pig kidney has now worked for a year in a patient, a xenotransplantation record
milestone.summary: Molly Falco, 58, transplanted on November 22, 2025 at Massachusetts General Hospital under the FDA's Expanded Access pathway, remains off dialysis one year later. The EGEN-2784 graft combines three classes of edits: inactivated porcine endogenous retroviruses, three glycan antigens removed and seven human transgenes inserted; six patients have received it to date.
milestone.why: It is the longest sustained function of a pig kidney in a living human, just ahead of the FDA-cleared Phase 1/2/3 RESTORE trial (33 waitlisted patients aged 50 to 70) slated for Q1 2027: multiplex genome editing is becoming a credible answer to the organ shortage.

deal.thesis: Sharon Mates, founder of Intra-Cellular Therapies (sold to J&J for $14.6B), launches Ritzey with Vida Ventures leading (Fidelity, Alexandria, EcoR1, Perceptive) after buying France's Perha Pharmaceuticals, whose oral DYRK1A kinase inhibitor has completed Phase 1. US capital is picking up an asset developed by a French biotech to take it into Phase 2 in Down syndrome and in type 1 and type 2 diabetes: a signal for European funds that let such assets slip away at an early stage.

brefsEurope.title: Novartis' siRNA Leqvio cuts major cardiovascular events in the Phase 3 ORION-4 trial
brefsEurope.summary: Added to standard care, including moderate-intensity statins, inclisiran produced a statistically significant reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: the first positive cardiovascular outcomes study for an siRNA. The effect size will be unveiled at a congress in the first half of 2027; a comparable that validates RNA modalities in large populations.

brefsEurope.title: Saniona ends its partnership with Medix and drops anti-obesity drug tesofensine from its pipeline
brefsEurope.summary: After Mexico's regulator COFEPRIS asked for an additional Phase 3, which Medix deemed commercially unviable, Saniona is dropping tesofensine and Tesomet to focus on neurology and psychiatry: SAN2668 (epileptic encephalopathies) and SAN2465 (depression), cleared by the FDA to enter Phase 1. Its partnerships (Jazz, Acadia, AstronauTx) have already brought in $75M and provide for up to $1.75B in milestone payments.

brefsEurope.title: Neumirna selected by the EIC Accelerator for up to €12.5M to take its epilepsy antimiR into the clinic
brefsEurope.summary: The Danish biotech receives a €2.5M grant and up to €10M in equity from the EIC Fund for a Phase 1/2 study of NMT.001, an antisense oligonucleotide that blocks microRNA miR-134 in focal drug-resistant epilepsy, with a first-in-human trial planned for 2027. It raised a €20M Series A in January 2025 (Angelini Ventures, Invivo Partners, Innovestor).

brefsEurope.title: IQVIA buys UK early-development provider Quotient Sciences from Permira
brefsEurope.summary: Quotient, which combines formulation, small-batch manufacturing, early-phase trials and bioanalysis ('Translational Pharmaceutics') at sites in Nottingham, Alnwick, Miami and Philadelphia, expects around $200M in 2026 revenue; the price was not disclosed. A comparable showing the value placed on tools that cut up to 12 months from a candidate's path to the clinic.

brefsIntl.title: Kymera's oral STAT6 degrader hits its primary endpoint in Phase 2b eczema, with Dupixent-like efficacy
brefsIntl.summary: In the BROADEN2 trial (244 patients), the mid dose of KT-621 cut EASI scores by 72% at 16 weeks (45 points better than placebo) and 62% of patients reached EASI-75 versus 22% on placebo. A Phase 3 is planned by mid-2027; shares jumped 34%, a strong signal for oral transcription-factor degradation.

brefsIntl.title: FDA approves BridgeBio's Welgemda, the first targeted therapy for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy LGMD2I/R9
brefsIntl.summary: An oral glycosylation substrate therapy that raises glycosylated alpha-dystroglycan, BBP-418 was approved ahead of its November 27 action date on the basis of the Phase 3 FORTIFY trial (112 patients), with the FDA citing improvements in walking speed and lung function.

brefsIntl.title: Curium wins FDA Fast Track designation for its copper-64 PSMA PET tracer in prostate cancer
brefsIntl.summary: A PET/CT imaging agent pairing a PSMA-targeting molecule with copper-64, Copper Cu 64 PSMA I&T is being evaluated in the SOLAR-STAGE (initial staging of unfavorable intermediate- to very high-risk cancers) and SOLAR-RECUR (suspected biochemical recurrence) studies. The nuclear medicine group keeps its international headquarters in Paris.

word.definition: A short, chemically reinforced synthetic RNA strand that sticks to a microRNA that is overactive in disease and stops it from switching off its target genes.

parts.label: Complementary sequence
parts.role: precisely recognizes the targeted microRNA (miR-134, miR-22, miR-23b…)

parts.label: Conjugate or route of administration
parts.role: brings the molecule to the right tissue (cholesterol, GalNAc, intrathecal, intravenous)

how.t: A microRNA overexpressed in disease can single-handedly repress dozens of messenger RNAs, like miR-23b, which holds back the MBNL protein in myotonic dystrophy type 1.
The antimiR hybridizes to the mature microRNA and neutralizes it or triggers its degradation, releasing the brake on its target genes.
Because one microRNA regulates many genes, a single molecule can correct a whole biological program, but the same cascade effect creates off-target risks that must be monitored.

word.why: After a rocky start (no antimiR has yet reached Phase 3 or approval), the field is returning through indications where the mechanism is well established: neurology, rare neuromuscular diseases, metabolism. For a VC, it is a capital-efficient modality built on advances in oligonucleotide chemistry, where Europe has several pure players and big pharma appetite has already been shown (Novo Nordisk's acquisition of Cardior, Sanofi's stake in Resalis).
